payload.body_you: {{holder1}} gets thanked for something you helped build, or the story of a shared win starts leaving your name out. You want to be happy for {{holder1}}, but it is hard to ignore the part where your work disappeared.
payload.body_they: Your work gets noticed and {{holder1}}'s contribution is barely mentioned. {{holder1}} may not care about getting the most attention. They care that the work they did is being treated like it did not happen.
